user.title: Choose Database Backend
user.description: Select the database engine to store entity observations.

data_description.db_type: SQLite is embedded (no server needed). MySQL and PostgreSQL require a running server.

embedded.title: Embedded Database Settings
embedded.description: Configure the local database file path and optional filters.

data.db_path: Database file path (relative to HA config directory)

data_description.db_path: Path to the database file. Created automatically if it does not exist.
data_description.exclude_domains: Domains whose entities will not be logged.
data_description.exclude_entities: Specific entity IDs that will not be logged.
data_description.exclude_attributes: Attribute names that will never be logged for any entity.

server.title: Database Server Settings
server.description: Configure the server connection and optional filters.

data_description.db_host: Hostname or IP address of the database server.
data_description.db_port: TCP port (default: 3306 for MySQL, 5432 for PostgreSQL).
data_description.db_name: Name of the database / schema to use.
data_description.db_username: Database user with CREATE TABLE and INSERT privileges.
data_description.exclude_domains: Domains whose entities will not be logged.
data_description.exclude_entities: Specific entity IDs that will not be logged.
data_description.exclude_attributes: Attribute names that will never be logged for any entity.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure HA External Recorder
reconfigure.description: Update the database connection and filter settings. The integration will reload automatically.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of HA External Recorder is allowed.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the database. Check the settings and try again.

data_description.flush_interval: How often buffered observations are written to the database. Lower values reduce data loss on crash but increase I/O.
data_description.queue_max_size: Maximum number of state snapshots held in memory before dropping. Increase if you have many fast-changing entities.
data_description.exclude_domains: Overrides the value set at setup. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
data_description.exclude_entities: Overrides the value set at setup. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
data_description.exclude_attributes: Overrides the value set at setup. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
